youtube.title: Why Candle Flames Are Shaped Like Teardrops 🕯️ #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
On Earth, a candle flame stretches upward into a teardrop. Hot gas is lighter than cool air, so it rises and pulls the flame upward, drawing fresh air in from below. In microgravity on the International Space Station, nothing rises, so the same flame becomes a small, dim, blue ball. NASA has studied candle flames in space for decades.
